company.description: GloGlo offers rapid glucose gummies designed for Type 1 diabetics, athletes, and other high-performance users who need fast carbohydrate intake. The gummies use a dextrose-forward formula to deliver 15 grams of carbohydrates per three-gummy serving. They are vegan, shelf-stable, and formulated to resist melting or fusing in hot conditions. The product emphasizes measured carb delivery with a flavor-focused gummy format instead of clinical tablets. Customers can buy one-time packs or use a subscription that ships multiple packs on a recurring basis.
